blocks.text: WHAT RUNS THROUGH THEM · OLD TESTAMENT · AGAIN AND AGAIN · OLD TESTAMENT PEOPLE · WHO QUOTES MOST
The Old Testament behind the letters: where it comes from, what is quoted again and again, and who quotes most.
Click a book or a collection to keep it and list every passage.

Every Old Testament passage the letters quote, traced from the book it comes from to the letters that quote it. The Psalms, Isaiah and the books of Moses carry most of the weight. John's letters quote no Old Testament passage; their one band is 1 John's allusion to Cain (Genesis 4:8).
The Old Testament passages quoted in more than one place in the letters.
James 2:23 · Quotation: "Abraham believed God"; KJV Genesis reads "he believed in the LORD".
32 Old Testament passages are quoted in more than one place in the letters.
The Old Testament people they name
The Old Testament people named in more than one collection.

Paul sets Adam against Christ ("as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive") and cites the order of creation in 1 Timothy; Jude dates Enoch as "the seventh from Adam". Romans 5:14 1 Corinthians 15:22 1 Timothy 2:13 Jude 1:14
How many Old Testament quotations each letter makes.
